text:
leah: Heads-up — I pushed a lightweight 'Prefix Hit-rate Explorer' Grafana panel to the eng-runtime dashboard. It slices hit-rate and token-saved by model, route, and customer for last 7d. Immediate flag: model-charlie /route: /assistant/chat for customer AcmeCorp in eu-west dropped from 72% -> 58% after the 2026-03-14 kernel change.

sam: Hmm, can you paste the query? link to dashboard?

leah: link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/abc123/prefix-hitrate-explorer

leah: PromQL I used (simplified):

```
sum by (model, route, customer) (increase(prefix_cache_hits_total{env="prod"}[7d]))
/ sum by (model, route, customer) (increase(prefix_cache_requests_total{env="prod"}[7d]))
```

sam: Nice. For token-saved we used:

```
sum by (model, route, customer) (increase(prefix_cache_tokens_saved_total{env="prod"}[7d]))
```

jordan: Profiling: after kernel change we saw more fragmentation in kv key layout. Tail latencies unchanged but KV misses up for longer sequences. Raw numbers:
- model-charlie /chat / AcmeCorp: hits 58% (was 72%), tokens_saved -26k/day
- global average minor move 70->68%

engbot: deploy 2026-03-14T03:12Z kernel-v2.4 applied to gpu pool-b

nehla: Possible keying regression — kernel introduced normalization that dropped whitespace trimming for system prompts. Try keying on normalized_prompt = normalize_space(prompt) + route + model_signature

mike: I prototyped a warmup script (node) that replays top 100 prefixes per-customer with backoff. Script attached: gist link https://gist.github.com/xxx

mike: snippet:

```
await fetch('/v1/infer', { body: JSON.stringify({model, prompt: prefix, route}) })
```

sam: We should add an alert: delta(hit-rate) > 10% vs baseline for top-5 customers. Also reserve a canary pool for kernel changes.

leah: Agreed. Action items:
1) Nehla to validate keying normalization + run offline hit sim (48h)
2) Jordan to profile kv layout and share trace (24h)
3) Mike to run warmup script for AcmeCorp and report token savings (48h)
4) Sam to add grafana alert and update runbook

leah: Anyone object to rollback kernel-v2.4 on pool-b while we validate?

jordan: +1 rollback if warmup doesn't recover hit-rate in 12h

engbot: rollback job scheduled: rollback-kernel-pool-b in 2h if ticket not closed

leah: Thanks — will update the thread with experiment results. :pray:
